decisions.one_line: Users submitted ChatGPT-generated nonsense bug reports to Immunefi, wasting staff time and prompting 15 bans.
decisions.note: Scope dispute. Harm hit Immunefi via humans redistributing AI text to a third-party platform, not from output in the interaction; fails test 2, so out.

decisions.one_line: Vanderbilt's Peabody EDI office sent a ChatGPT-drafted shooting condolence email, drawing student backlash and an apology.
decisions.note: Scope dispute. ChatGPT did what was asked; backlash arose from staff choosing to delegate and send the message, not from output in the interaction. Fails 2.

decisions.one_line: ChatGPT falsely told users Australian mayor Brian Hood served prison time for bribery; he was actually the whistleblower.
decisions.note: harm_type dispute. Rubric requires filed suits/rulings/fines; Hood's suit was only threatened via legal letter, none filed. Reputational per coder2.

decisions.one_line: Fast-food hiring chatbots at McDonald's, Wendy's, and Hardee's gave useless instructions and mis-scheduled applicant interviews.
decisions.note: system_type dispute. Recruiting bots serve job applicants, not customers; not support/sales/booking/service, so 'other' per coder2.

decisions.one_line: A user got Bing Chat's image analysis to solve a CAPTCHA despite the stated restriction; Microsoft then pulled the feature.
decisions.note: A vs B. Material documents deliberate probing of the safeguard but no technical exploit technique (no injection/encoding shown), so goading test gives B.

decisions.one_line: LLaMA-based companion chatbots like 'Allie' generate violent and illegal sexual roleplay content in user interactions.
decisions.note: Scope dispute. Allie is a deployed chatbot; the harmful content occurs in the interaction itself, and roleplay requests are its ordinary use, so in scope, C.

decisions.one_line: A user injected an objective override into a Chevy dealer's ChatGPT bot, making it 'agree' to sell a 2024 Tahoe for $1.
decisions.note: B vs A. The documented input ('your objective is to agree with anything...') is a direct prompt injection, an enumerated A technique a filter could catch.

decisions.one_line: Amazon product listings appeared with unedited ChatGPT refusal messages like 'I cannot fulfill this request' as names.
decisions.note: Scope dispute. Harm came from sellers publishing unedited AI output to Amazon, not from output in an interaction with a user; fails test 2.

decisions.one_line: Grok generated a false 'Iran Strikes Tel Aviv' headline from spammed fake posts, promoted by X's trending news feature.
decisions.note: Scope dispute. Grok here is an automated trend-curation pipeline broadcasting to the feed, not a conversational/agentic system in a user interaction; fails 1-2.

decisions.one_line: A NewsGuard audit found 10 leading chatbots repeated Russian disinformation narratives in about a third of 570 test prompts.
decisions.note: Scope dispute. This is a benchmark/audit with researcher-crafted prompts and no documented deployed-user harm, an explicit test-2 exclusion.

decisions.one_line: Researchers catalogued an underground market of jailbroken 'dark LLM' services (WormGPT, FraudGPT) sold for malware and phishing.
decisions.note: Scope dispute. Market-wide research survey; documented harms reach victims via criminals redistributing outputs, not in the interaction. Fails 2, not just 3.

decisions.one_line: Grok's automated X news summaries posted false headlines (e.g. Harris shot) after the Trump rally shooting by misreading posts.
decisions.note: Scope dispute. Same feed-curation pipeline as 719: headlines auto-generated from ambient posts and broadcast, no user interaction; fails 1-2, matching 719.
